articles.title: Check Point Warns of Management Server Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks
articles.summary:
Attackers exploited a previously unknown flaw in Check Point's Security Management Server in a handful of targeted attacks on July 23, the company said.

articles.title: WordPress Issues Patch for Critical Flaw That Can Enable Code Execution on Some Servers
articles.summary:
WordPress has fixed a critical flaw in its core software that lets an attacker with no account make a site load a PHP file from outside its theme folders.

articles.title: Malicious npm Package Poses as Twilio Bug-Bounty Probe, Can Exfiltrate Credentials
articles.summary:
Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a malicious npm package named "tw-pkgprobe-7731" that masquerades as a security tool targeting developers integrating Twilio into their applications, while stealthily attempting to harvest sensitive data.

The package, named "tw-pkgprobe-7731," was first uploaded to the npm registry in mid-August 2026 by an npm account named "twdepprobe7731."

articles.summary:

articles.title: New Linux Kernel Flaw Gives ARM64 KVM Guests Read-Write Access to Host Memory
articles.summary:
A new flaw in the Linux kernel's KVM virtualization code for ARM64 processors can leave a freed piece of host memory exposed to a guest virtual machine on hosts with nested virtualization enabled.

The bug, tracked as CVE-2026-89775, allows a guest to read and write host kernel memory, and the researcher who found it says it can be used to escape the guest and run code on the host machine.

articles.title: Malicious npm Package indexed-btree Hid Its Loader in Runtime Code Before Removal
articles.summary:

articles.title: One Hidden Meta Muse Setting Could Let Attackers Turn the AI Assistant Into a Backdoor
articles.summary:
Malware already running on a Mac can quietly take over Meta's Muse assistant and use the broad access its owner granted the app, security researcher Patrick Wardle has shown in a proof-of-concept released on September 21.

articles.title: WordPress Comment2Shell Flaw Can Turn Anonymous Comment XSS Into RCE via Admin Session
articles.summary:
A new flaw in WordPress core let an anonymous visitor leave a comment that planted a hidden script on the page. If a logged-in administrator later opened that page, the script could run code on the site's server.
